blocks.content: Since Fibonacci(1) is a base case whose value is stored in fib, it returns 1 (i.e. fib[1]) to Fibonacci(2).
Then, Fibonacci(2) calls Fibonacci(0), which is another base case. As a result, it returns 0 to Fibonacci(2).
